tools.name: find_bonuses
tools.description: Find current US bank account bonuses a person can get: cash a bank pays for opening a checking, savings or fintech account and meeting its requirements. Use this for questions like 'what bank bonuses can I get in Ohio', 'bonuses that need no direct deposit', 'best checking bonus with no monthly fee'

tools.name: get_payout_timeline
tools.description: See how long a bank takes to pay a bonus after the account is opened, from community reports and the offer's own terms. Use it for 'how long until Chase pays the bonus' or 'when will my Wells Fargo bonus post'.

tools.name: whats_changed

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_payout_timeline · Public sink: get_payout_timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_payout_timeline · Public sink: get_payout_timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
